annotations.title: Current jobs ranked for this person

description: Current jobs ranked for this person. Searches live jobs for their roles and places, leaves out anything they dismissed, applied to or excluded, and ranks by the same fixed match score. Each match says how it would be applied to (apply_route: jobspotter, email, robot or you). A ready-to-read summary is in `say`.

min_score.description: Only matches at or above this score.

where.description: A place, if not their usual one.
